From Needling to Whole-Person Response

The Needle Is More Than Insertion.

Needling, intention, Qi, Dao Yin, movement and clinical response interact within a dynamic therapeutic process.

From Xing–Shen to Brain–Body Interaction

Traditional Chinese medicine and contemporary neuroscience offer different conceptual frameworks through which relationships among body, movement, awareness, intention and function can be explored. These concepts are placed in dialogue without treating Shen as equivalent to the brain or Qi as equivalent to a specific biomedical mechanism.
